title: Stage 1 Taxonomy Bindings
description: Canonical registries referenced by SKILL.md §4. Sourced verbatim from the existing tools/harness_vision_analyst.py and tools/STAGE_2_MANIFEST_AUTHORING_PROMPT.md canonical vocabularies as of the v3 audit. This file is the single place these lists live — do not hardcode them elsewhere.

primitive_registry.description: Canonical primitive_type values. A value from this list must never appear in a slide_role field (see Regression Case 1).

slide_role_registry.description: Canonical candidate_slide_role values. A value from this list must never appear in a primitive_type field.

grammar_registry.description: How roles and structures compose across a harness's slide sequence. Not yet populated from the legacy corpus — the coding agent must derive this from cross-specimen analysis during calibration (SKILL.md §10), not invent it. Leave as an empty, explicitly-typed array until real evidence populates it.

taxonomy_candidate_states.description: The only legal states for any taxonomy item, in any registry.

notes: This file intentionally contains no field related to licensing, provenance-completeness, or usability of source media — see SKILL.md §0.
grammar_registry.canonical is empty by design and must be populated only from real evidence gathered during calibration, not pre-filled.
